tasks.name: rename-env-var
tasks.prompt: Rename the environment variable PYTOOL_CACHE to PYTOOL_CACHE_DIR everywhere it is read or documented.
tasks.check: grep -q PYTOOL_CACHE_DIR pytool/config.py && grep -q PYTOOL_CACHE_DIR README.md && ! grep -qE 'PYTOOL_CACHE([^_]|$)' pytool/config.py README.md

tasks.name: fix-duration-bug
tasks.prompt: parse_duration("1h30m") returns 90. It should return 5400, the number of seconds. Fix it.
tasks.check: python3 -c "from pytool.duration import parse_duration as p; import sys; sys.exit(0 if p('1h30m') == 5400 and p('45s') == 45 and p('2m') == 120 else 1)"

tasks.name: why-question
tasks.prompt: Why does the CLI read the config file twice on startup?

tasks.name: add-quiet-flag
tasks.prompt: Add a --quiet flag to the CLI that suppresses the summary line.
tasks.check: out=$(python3 -m pytool.cli --quiet sample.txt) && ! printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q summary && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q seconds && python3 -m pytool.cli sample.txt | grep -q summary
